dpl_log_1: Khalad: Halbeegga '$1' ayaa khaldan: '$2'! Caawimo: $1= xarig madhan (Main)$3.

dpl_log_3: Khalad: Qaybo aad u badan! Ugu badnaan: $1. Help: kordhi $wgDPLMaxCategoryCount si aad u qeexdo qaybo badan ama u deji $wgDPLAllowUnlimitedCategories = true; si aan xaddidnaan loo yeelan. (Doorsoomaha ku deji faylka qaabaynta wiki-ga ee LocalSettings.php.)
dpl_log_4: Khalad: Qaybo aad u yar! Ugu yaraan: $1. Help: hoos u dhig $wgDPLMinCategoryCount si aad u qeexdo qaybo yar. (Doorsoomaha ku deji faylka qaabaynta wiki-ga ee LocalSettings.php.)
dpl_log_5: Khalad: Shuruudaha xulashada lama helin! Waa inaad isticmaashaa ugu yaraan mid ka mid ah halbeegyada soo socda: category, namespace, titlematch, linksto, uses, createdby, modifiedby, lastmodifiedby, ama noocyadooda 'not'.
dpl_log_6: Khalad: Ugu yaraan hal qayb waa in la doortaa si loo isticmaalo 'addfirstcategorydate=true' ama 'ordermethod=categoryadd'.
dpl_log_7: Khalad: Haddii aad ku darto wax ka badan hal qayb, ma isticmaali kartid 'addfirstcategorydate=true' ama 'ordermethod=categoryadd'.
dpl_log_8: Khalad: Hal nooc oo taariikh ah oo keliya ayaa mar kasta lagu dari karaa.
dpl_log_9: Khalad: Halbeegga '$1' waa in lagu isticmaalaa 'ordermethod=[ $2 ]'
dpl_log_10: Khalad: Tusmada qaybta ugu weyn waa inay u dhexeysaa 1 iyo tirada halbeegyada includepage (xaaladdan $0).
dpl_log_11: Khalad: Hawlgallo macquul ah laguma samayn karo bogagga aan qaybta lahayn (tusaale ahaan, iyadoo la adeegsanayo halbeegga 'category') sababtoo ah aragtida $0 kama jirto kaydka xogta! Help: maamulka kaydka xogta ha fuliyo weydiintan: $1.
dpl_log_12: Khalad: Qeexidda "openreferences" kuma habboona ikhtiyaar kale oo la qeexay. Fadlan ka saar ikhtiyaarka kale ama "openreferences". Faahfaahinta ka eeg buugga tilmaamaha.
dpl_log_13: Digniin: Halbeegga aan la aqoon '$1' waa la iska indhatiray. Help: halbeegyada la heli karo: $2.
dpl_log_14: Digniin: Ikhtiyaarka khaldan '$2' ayaa laga booday halbeegga '$1'.
dpl_log_15: Digniin: Halbeegga '$1' ayaa khaldan: '$2'! Waxaa la isticmaalayaa qiimaha caadiga ah: '$3' (xaddidnaan la'aan). Help: $1= xarig madhan (xaddidnaan la'aan) | n, iyadoo n uu yahay tiro togan oo dhan.
dpl_log_17: Digniin: Halbeegyada Add* ('adduser', 'addeditdate', iwm.) iyo 'includepage' wax saameyn ah kuma yeeshaan 'mode=category'. Habkan waxaa lagu arki karaa oo keliya meel magaca bogga/magaca bogga.
dpl_log_18: Digniin: 'headingmode=$1' wax saameyn ah kuma laha 'ordermethod' marka uu ka kooban yahay hal qayb. Waxaa la isticmaalayaa: '$2'. Help: waxaad isticmaali kartaa qiimayaasha 'headingmode' ee aan ahayn-$2 marka 'ordermethod' uu ka kooban yahay dhowr qaybood. Qaybta koowaad ayaa loo isticmaalaa cinwaannada. Tusaale ahaan, 'ordermethod=category,comp' (comp waa qayb kale) ayaa loo isticmaalaa cinwaannada qaybaha.

dpl_log_20: Digniin: Wareeg aan dhammaad lahayn oo ku-celinta bogagga ah ayaa uu abuurayaa bogga '$0'.
dpl_log_22: Digniin: Ikhtiyaar halbeeg ah looma sheegin '$1'. (Waxaa ka maqan '=')
dpl_log_23: Khalad: Liiska lama soo bandhigi karo sababtoo ah adeegayaashu way buux-dhaafeen. Fadlan mar kale isku day goor dambe.

Farriinta khaladku waxay ahayd:
$2
